I am planting beans on this small plot of mine here in Morogoro. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they feed the soil themselves. I cannot afford to waste money on chemical fertilizer for a plot this small, and the shop is far. I will use seed I saved from last harvest, as I always do, and I and my family will do the weeding ourselves with the jembe.
